actions.message: Average contribution is low; please contribute at least 80% of your wallet this round to strengthen the pool for everyone.

answer.explanation: Average contribution fell below 30% of endowment, so I boost my contribution to the maximum wallet amount (baseline 80% plus 30% extra). I also broadcast a reminder to encourage higher contributions.
